name: Boston
title: Michelin Star Restaurants in Boston: Are There Any? ({year})
description: Yes, one: 311 Omakase holds Boston's only Michelin star, from the first MICHELIN Guide Northeast Cities in 2025. Its 18-course omakase costs $280 a head.
lead: Yes, one. 311 Omakase, an 18-course Japanese omakase in the South End, holds Boston's only Michelin star, won in November 2025 in the first MICHELIN Guide to cover the city. That Northeast Cities guide also gave Boston six Bib Gourmands and 19 recommended restaurants.
intro: The 2026 selection for Boston, Chicago, New York, Philadelphia and Washington DC is revealed in New York on December 14, 2026, and this page is updated that night. Prices are in US dollars, per person before tax and tip, checked October 2026.
